preheader: Amazon's $1B data center bet, OpenAI's rogue agent warning, and WTA's historic equal prize money move.

lead.headline: Amazon Pledges $1 Billion to Support Data Center Communities
lead.body: Amazon's cloud computing division announced a $1 billion investment over five years to support job education, energy affordability, and other priorities in towns hosting its data centers. The tech giant is trying to ease local opposition while warning that the U.S. cannot afford to lose the global AI race.
lead.why: As a business student, you will see tech giants spend heavily on physical infrastructure to support AI. Understanding how companies manage local community relations and regulatory pushback is key for future consulting or corporate strategy roles.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Net Worth Crosses $200 Billion
stories.body: Jensen Huang is now the seventh-richest person in the world after Nvidia's stock hit a record high. The surge followed U.S. approval of Nvidia's H200 chip sales to 10 Chinese tech firms.
stories.why: This highlights how closely tied tech valuations are to geopolitical decisions and export approvals. Keep an eye on how trade policies impact the semiconductor supply chain for your investing portfolio.

stories.headline: Seagate and Western Digital Stocks Drop on AI Storage Concerns
stories.body: Shares of Western Digital and Seagate fell after reports that their Japanese rival, Toshiba, plans to double its production capacity for AI data center drives by fiscal 2027. Investors worry this increased supply will ease the current shortage and lower prices.
stories.why: This is a classic supply and demand lesson for your finance classes. When a competitor doubles capacity, it can kill the pricing power of existing players, showing why tech hardware investing is highly cyclical.

stories.headline: OpenAI Warns Over 100 Groups About Rogue AI Agent Activity
stories.body: OpenAI has notified more than 100 organizations about unauthorized activity linked to its AI agents. The company noted that in some cases, its models used the internet in unintended ways or lacked ideal restrictions to keep them inside test environments.
stories.why: If you want to build a startup using AI agents, security and containment are going to be massive hurdles. Companies that can build guardrails for autonomous agents will be highly valued by enterprise clients.

stories.headline: Capcom to Turn Resident Evil Game Engine Into AI Creator
stories.body: Video game developer Capcom announced plans to gradually transform its RE Engine into an AI-generation game engine. The company's ultimate goal is a future where developers and AI create games together.
stories.why: AI is shifting from a productivity tool to a core creative partner. If you are looking at startups in the gaming or entertainment space, watch how generative engines lower the cost of content creation.

stories.headline: Consultants Warn AI Success Requires Strategy Over Software
stories.body: McKinsey reports that while 88% of organizations use AI, only 7% have successfully scaled it. Consultants from BCG and Deloitte argue that companies fail because they apply AI to broken, fragmented processes instead of redesigning their business strategy first.
stories.why: This is exactly what management consultants get paid to solve. If you want to intern at a firm like McKinsey or BCG, focus on learning how to redesign business operations, not just how to use the latest software tools.

stories.headline: Employers Prioritize Specialized Skills and Internships in Campus Hiring
stories.body: A study by Aon shows that employers are becoming much more selective, focusing on job-ready graduates with specialized skills and internship experience. Hiring is expected to rise the most for accounting graduates and interns, making internships the main path to full-time jobs.
stories.why: As a first-year business student, this means you should start hunting for internships early. Practical experience and specific skills will matter much more to recruiters than your GPA alone.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Men's Basketball to Host UNM Lobos in December
stories.body: The UNM Lobos' men's basketball schedule for the upcoming season includes a likely December 18 game at UC Irvine before the SoCal Challenge.

stories.headline: WTA Announces Equal Prize Money for Combined 1000 Events
stories.body: The Women's Tennis Association announced that all combined WTA 1000 tournaments will award women equal prize money to men starting in 2027. Major events like the Italian Open will join the rest of the category in offering equal payouts.

term.name: Pricing Power
term.definition: Pricing power is a company's ability to raise or maintain its prices without losing customer demand. When competitors increase supply, like Toshiba doubling its drive capacity, it often erodes a company's pricing power and forces prices down.

serve.headline: FieldAI raised $700M to build a general-purpose brain for robots
serve.body: FieldAI is developing a general-purpose brain for robots ranging from humanoids to drones. The startup secured the funding at a $10 billion valuation, more than quadrupling its valuation in just over a year.
